title: Meta annual capital expenditure
definition: Purchases of property and equipment reported on Meta Platforms, Inc.'s Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows, covering data centers, servers, and network infrastructure.

sources.title: Form 8-K Exhibit 99.1: Meta Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Results

points.evidence: Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows, 'Purchases of property and equipment', Twelve Months Ended December 31, 2024: $37,256 million.
Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows, 'Purchases of property and equipment', Twelve Months Ended December 31, 2025: $69,691 million.
